faqData.question: What is the dress code?
faqData.answer:
All guests are kindly requested to wear formal attire in BLACK & WHITE only.

• For ladies: A WHITE formal dress, skirt, or trousers
• For gentlemen: BLACK formal attire (polo, long sleeves, or suit) with black shoes
• For 18 Roses participants: Strictly required to wear formal wear such as a tuxedo.

Strictly no slippers, crocs, or overly casual footwear, as this is a formal event.

faqData.question: What time should I arrive?
faqData.answer: Please arrive at least 30–40 minutes before the program starts to avoid disruption and ensure you are properly seated.

faqData.question: Can I bring a plus one / my child?
faqData.answer: This celebration is limited to invited guests only unless otherwise stated, due to limited seating capacity. Thank you for your understanding.

faqData.question: Is RSVP required?
faqData.answer: Yes, RSVP is highly required. Kindly confirm your attendance so the debutante can finalize the guest count for seating, catering, and program planning.

faqData.question: Is there parking available?
faqData.answer: Yes, designated parking areas will be available at the venue for the convenience of all guests.

faqData.question: Is there a gift preference?
faqData.answer: No gift is required—your presence is more than enough. However, suggested gift ideas are provided for guidance, but you are free to give any gift of your choice.

faqData.question: Is there a strict seating arrangement?
faqData.answer: Yes. Each guest has an assigned seat. Kindly remain at your designated table and refrain from transferring seats.

faqData.question: Is there an after-party or additional activity?
faqData.answer: Yes! There will be a Happy Hour (Disco Hour) after the program. Guests are welcome to join and enjoy 2 hours of dancing and celebration. Feel free to stay, have fun, and celebrate with us!
